scope.menus: shared panels, buttons, resource bar, navigation, equipment, shop, castle, settings/subwindows, details, inventory grids, combat HUD and title

runtime.castles-open-v2.png: Exactly registered open-facade counterparts; same roof, outer silhouette, chassis and outdoor deck.

castle_coordinate_system.upgrades: Existing castleProgress.parts[0][0..4], levels 0..5, remain independent. Changing levels does not move floor, sockets or wheel axes.
castle_coordinate_system.interior: Existing tap-to-open state; the closed facade hides residents and is restored after room rendering.
castle_coordinate_system.allies: Stand behind commander toward the castle, with fixed spacing; back-plane cannon renders before characters.
castle_coordinate_system.registration: 3 columns, column stride 658; 2 rows, row stride 389; source cell x=20+column*658, y=row*389, size638x389. Roof y0..175; facade x0..415/y175..315. No independent horizontal/vertical stretch.

environment_coverage: First-region far/mid layers cover full viewport uniformly and stay horizontally centered; pixel boss shares far-layer coverage and phase.
fleet_registration: fleet-registration.json and Classes/Data/HybridCastleFleet.h; produced by tools/castles/measure_hybrid_fleet.py without modifying PNGs.
fleet_capacity: Authored gameplay floor count restored exactly: castle index+1 floors. Each floor uses its own original room theme and original upgrade artwork.
fleet_lobby: Existing left/right arrows switch castles. Tap the castle to open/close interior. Initial tall silhouettes fit below lobby distance card; manual zoom stays available.
castle_rendering: Classes/CastleModularDebug.h uses original unarmed rigs, original mounted cannon atlas, original floor-specific rectangular rooms and matching original axle data. RGB-only material treatment: Classes/AuthoredCastleTone.inc.
fleet_status: REJECTED: generated hybrid starter/fleet geometry is no longer used by the castle, inventory weapon or castle-menu rendering paths. Retained only as archived draft assets.
tone: Existing castle PNG pixels and texture coordinates are unchanged. Shader changes RGB only; alpha, silhouette, deck, wall, prop and weapon shapes are preserved. Characters/bosses excluded.
royal: Width 480 versus original 422 (+13.744%); original aspect ratio and all source anchors retained. Warm inlay glints affect only existing gold, not the silhouette.
